report.symptom: 4P completion followed by 3P in the same app session leaves the shortcut reporting multiplayer data unconfirmed. Restarting the app restores 3P input.
report.limits: The source contains a concrete stale-latch path consistent with the report; this does not establish which intermediate reads occurred on the device.

source_evidence.reader: PHNativeOrbEngine read retained _sawMultiplayer, _multiplayerKind and _multiplayerDisabled until Read returned success with present=false.
source_evidence.early_gate: Read compared the new mode with the old observed mode before reading dungeon entry identity, so a skipped menu followed by mode 11 to mode 7 latched the new match permanently.
source_evidence.sampling: PHOrbSession afterFrame throttles idle reads and can receive unavailable foreground/account/scene reads; absence of a successful menu sample is not proof that the match is unchanged.
source_evidence.ui: PHOrbSession snapshot reports multiplayer data unconfirmed when liveReadable is false, including a retained multiplayerDisabled latch.

change.read_policy: Read and confirm scene, account, entry hash, dungeon/floor, modes and matching active game implementation before selecting a mode gate. Confirm again after the complete read; publish latch changes only on success. Existing multiplayer double-read checks remain required.
change.new_entry: Retire the previous mode latch and all captured multiplayer gesture state; read the current mode under its ordinary checks. Readiness does not create input intent.
change.same_entry: Retain unsupported/changed-mode latch before board or leader reads. Selector reset cannot masquerade as a new single-player battle.
change.failed_entry: An empty hash, loading scene, read error or identity race cannot retire or rebind the previous latch.
change.scope: Orb local one-shot reader only. No changes to team, skill, BGM, timer or network mutation policies.

cases: One production engine across every 3/4/8P pair, including identical game allocation and no observed menu.
Established same-entry latch recovers on a verified new hash; mode/dungeon change alone remains blocked before board reads.
Empty nonce, loading scene and early/late identity races preserve the previous latch, then a complete new-entry read recovers.
Unsupported new match remains blocked; following supported match can recover independently.
Old arm and held token never carry into the new match, including reused token addresses; new explicit gesture completes and restores the input manager.
Session cancels old worker/gesture, handles an unavailable intermediate read, and restores shortcut readiness without automatic input.
The same overlay changes from unavailable after 4P to eligible 3P and dispatches only on a new explicit tap.
